document.title: Enterprise AI agent platform on Dify
document.produced_by: Reference sample written in the Requirements Analyzer format (see ../README.md)

application.name: Dify
application.license: Dify Open Source License (Apache 2.0 with additional conditions)
application.summary: A platform for building LLM apps, RAG pipelines, workflows and agents through a visual console and APIs. The API, workers and web console are Python and Next.js; code execution and plugins run in separate Go services.

components.name: API
components.role: Console and app APIs, streaming responses, orchestration of models, tools and retrieval

components.name: Worker and beat
components.role: Document indexing, workflow tasks, scheduled jobs

components.name: Sandbox
components.role: Runs user-supplied Python and Node.js code with seccomp restrictions

components.name: Plugin daemon
components.role: Installs and runs model-provider, tool and extension plugins

components.name: SSRF proxy
components.role: Forward proxy for outbound HTTP from the API, workers, sandbox and plugins

detected_signals.signal: 39 services in the Compose file: api, api_websocket, worker, worker_beat, web, sandbox, plugin_daemon, agent_backend, two SSRF proxies, nginx, databases and vector stores
detected_signals.implies: Container platform; most services are stateless

detected_signals.signal: Celery workers and beat scheduler with a Redis broker
detected_signals.evidence: docker/docker-compose.yaml: worker MODE=worker, worker_beat MODE=beat; CELERY_BROKER_URL
detected_signals.implies: Managed Redis-compatible cache with TLS, non-clustered for Celery

detected_signals.signal: File storage defaults to a local OpenDAL filesystem; the AWS sample switches it to S3
detected_signals.evidence: docker/.env.example: STORAGE_TYPE=opendal; aws-samples CDK lib/constructs/dify-services/api.ts: STORAGE_TYPE 's3'
detected_signals.implies: Shared object storage (Amazon S3) so API and worker tasks can scale out

detected_signals.signal: Pluggable vector store; pgvector and OpenSearch are among more than a dozen options
detected_signals.evidence: docker/docker-compose.yaml: pgvector, opensearch, qdrant, weaviate, milvus, and others; VECTOR_STORE
detected_signals.implies: Choose a vector store that fits scale and operations

detected_signals.signal: User-supplied code runs in DifySandbox, with network enabled by default
detected_signals.evidence: docker/docker-compose.yaml: sandbox ENABLE_NETWORK default true, WORKER_TIMEOUT 15
detected_signals.implies: Strong isolation and egress control for untrusted code

detected_signals.signal: Outbound HTTP from api, worker, plugin daemon and sandbox goes through a Squid SSRF proxy
detected_signals.implies: Egress allowlist, and blocking of internal address ranges

detected_signals.signal: Plugin daemon installs third-party plugins, with a 50 MB package limit
detected_signals.implies: Supply-chain control: only reviewed plugins from an internal source

detected_signals.signal: Agent backend with a local shell sandbox, separated from the API by its own proxy
detected_signals.implies: Highest-risk component; isolate it or defer it

detected_signals.signal: AWS reference deployment: ECS Fargate, Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 (2 ACU max) with pgvector, ElastiCache Valkey (cache.t4g.micro), S3, ALB, SES, and VPC endpoints for Bedrock
detected_signals.implies: A proven AWS baseline, sized for small teams

detected_signals.signal: In the AWS sample, the sandbox and plugin daemon run as sidecars in the API task and share its IAM role
detected_signals.implies: User code shares the API's network namespace and credentials unless it is split out

detected_signals.signal: Licence conditions: operating multiple workspaces (tenants) or removing the console logo needs a commercial licence
Single sign-on is an Enterprise Edition feature
detected_signals.implies: Community Edition cannot meet an SSO mandate on its own

scenario.summary: A firm wants an internal platform where teams build chat assistants, RAG apps, workflows and agents over internal documents. All model inference must go through Amazon Bedrock in-region; every prompt, response and tool call is audited.
assumptions: About 200 published apps and 40 team workspaces
Knowledge bases of up to 2 million chunks in total
Access only from the corporate network; no public endpoint
out_of_scope: Customer-facing apps on the public internet

functional_requirements.statement: Teams build chat apps, workflows and agents with retrieval over internal documents
Employees use published apps in the web UI; internal services call them through app API keys
Each team gets its own workspace with separate apps, knowledge bases and usage reporting
Workflows can run code and call HTTP tools
Only security-reviewed plugins and tools are available

non_functional_requirements.statement: Models come only from Amazon Bedrock in the approved region; no traffic to other LLM APIs
non_functional_requirements.target: 100% of model calls through Bedrock VPC endpoints; other model providers disabled

non_functional_requirements.statement: Single sign-on with MFA for every user, and prompt deprovisioning
non_functional_requirements.target: Access removed within 1 hour of leaving

non_functional_requirements.statement: Untrusted code runs with no credentials, no direct network access and resource limits
non_functional_requirements.target: 0 IAM permissions in the sandbox task; 15-second execution limit

non_functional_requirements.statement: Prompts and responses are screened for PII and harmful content
non_functional_requirements.target: Bedrock Guardrails on 100% of production apps

non_functional_requirements.statement: Prompts, responses, tool calls and user identity are retained for audit and cannot be altered
All outbound HTTP from the platform goes through an allowlisting proxy that blocks internal and metadata addresses
non_functional_requirements.target: 0 direct egress paths from application tasks

non_functional_requirements.statement: Documents, embeddings and conversations stay in the region, encrypted with customer-managed keys
non_functional_requirements.target: 100% of stores use KMS customer-managed keys

non_functional_requirements.statement: The platform survives the loss of one availability zone
Platform overhead stays small compared with model latency
non_functional_requirements.target: p95 platform overhead under 300 ms, excluding model inference

non_functional_requirements.statement: Serve peak load and large knowledge bases
non_functional_requirements.target: 800 concurrent sessions; 50 requests per second; 2 million chunks

non_functional_requirements.statement: Queue depth and task failures are monitored and alerted
non_functional_requirements.target: Alert when the Celery queue backlog exceeds 5 minutes

non_functional_requirements.statement: Model spend is attributed to each team, with budgets
non_functional_requirements.target: Monthly Bedrock cost per workspace; alert at 80% of budget

non_functional_requirements.statement: Recover the platform in a second region from backups

policy_conflicts.summary: SSO and per-team workspaces are required, but SSO is Enterprise-only and multi-workspace operation needs a commercial licence.
policy_conflicts.proposed_resolution: License Dify Enterprise for SSO and multiple workspaces, subject to vendor risk assessment.

policy_conflicts.summary: Workflows run user-supplied code. In the AWS sample that code shares the API task's network namespace and IAM role.
policy_conflicts.proposed_resolution: Run the sandbox as its own service in an isolated subnet with no task role; its only route out is the SSRF proxy.

policy_conflicts.summary: The agent backend's local shell sandbox gives agents a general-purpose shell.
policy_conflicts.proposed_resolution: Leave the agent backend off at launch, and enable it after a dedicated security review.

open_questions.question: Do knowledge bases need per-document access control that mirrors the source systems?
Which external APIs belong on the egress allowlist for tools?

scoring.rubric: Mean of 12 parts: ten NFR categories (1 = numeric target, 0.5 = requirement without one, 0 = none), functional coverage, and conflict resolution; minus 0.05 per blocking open question. See ../README.md.
